effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([VB] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Security] [Your Turn] When one of your level 4 or higher [VB] trait Digimon attacks, you may play 1 [VB] trait Digimon card of the same level from your hand with the cost reduced by 3.
[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand and place this card face up as the bottom security card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [VB] trait card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
